title: Reflexive verbs
goal: Describe your morning and evening routine with reflexive verbs like se lever and se coucher, and ask others about theirs.

items.fr: je me, tu te, il se, nous nous, vous vous, ils se

drills.en: What time do you wake up?
drills.explain: With vous, the pronoun is also vous: vous vous réveillez.

drills.en: They go to bed at 10 p.m.
drills.explain: ils and elles take se, like il and elle.
me becomes m' before a vowel, and the verb is conjugated: je m'habille.

items.fr: je me lève, nous nous levons
items.en: se lever: è when the ending is silent

drills.en: What time do you get up?
drills.explain: The ending -es is silent, so the e before it becomes è: tu te lèves.
The ending -ons is heard, so no accent: nous nous levons.
-ent is silent, so è: elles se lèvent.

items.note: je me lève, nous nous levons

items.en: to shower, to take a shower

items.note: je m'habille, tu t'habilles, il s'habille

example.fr: Les enfants se couchent à 20 heures.
example.en: The children go to bed at 8 p.m.

items.fr: Tu te lèves à quelle heure ?
items.en: What time do you get up? (to a friend)
accept: À quelle heure tu te lèves ?
À quelle heure est-ce que tu te lèves ?

blocks.title: Planning the morning in a shared apartment in Montréal
blocks.context: Lucie and Nguyen share an apartment with Olivier. They have only one bathroom.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Nguyen, tu te lèves à quelle heure le matin ?
lines.en: Nguyen, what time do you get up in the morning?

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Je me lève à 6 heures. Je me douche, je m'habille et je me brosse les dents. Je commence à 7 h 30.
lines.en: I get up at 6. I shower, I get dressed and I brush my teeth. I start at 7:30.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Six heures ! C'est tôt ! Moi, je me réveille à 7 heures.
lines.en: Six o'clock! That's early! Me, I wake up at 7.

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Alors, je me douche à 6 heures et toi, à 7 heures. D'accord ?
lines.en: So I shower at 6 and you at 7. OK?

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: D'accord ! Et le soir, tu te couches à quelle heure ?
lines.en: OK! And in the evening, what time do you go to bed?

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Je me couche à 22 heures. Et toi ?
lines.en: I go to bed at 10 p.m. And you?

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Moi, je me couche tard, à minuit.
lines.en: Me, I go to bed late, at midnight.

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Et Olivier ? Il se lève à quelle heure ?
lines.en: And Olivier? What time does he get up?

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Olivier ? Il se réveille à 9 heures, il se lave, il s'habille… et il commence à 10 heures !
lines.en: Olivier? He wakes up at 9, he washes, he gets dressed… and he starts at 10!

blocks.body: Listen for the little words before each verb: [[je **me** lève]], [[tu **te** couches]], [[il **se** lave]]. They are the key to this lesson.

blocks.title: A reflexive verb has an extra pronoun
blocks.body:
Some French verbs describe an action you do **to yourself**. They have an extra little pronoun before the verb: [[me]], [[te]], [[se]], [[nous]], [[vous]], [[se]]. In the dictionary they are listed with [[se]]: [[se lever]], [[se coucher]].

You already know one! [[Je m'appelle Lucie]] literally means *I call myself Lucie*.

The verb part is a normal **-er** verb: same endings as [[travailler]].

blocks.title: Se coucher (to go to bed)
head: pronoun
verb
English
rows: you go to bed (formal or plural)
blocks.note: Yes, [[nous nous]] and [[vous vous]] really repeat the word. The first is the subject, the second is the reflexive pronoun.

blocks.title: Before a vowel: m', t', s'
head: s'habiller (to get dressed)
blocks.note: [[me]], [[te]], [[se]] drop their e before a vowel or a silent h, like [[je]] → [[j']]. [[Nous]] and [[vous]] don't change, but they link with a *z* sound: [[nous‿habillons]].

blocks.title: Se lever: watch the accent
head: se lever (to get up)
blocks.note: When the ending is silent (-e, -es, -ent), the e of the stem becomes **è** and sounds open, like *eh*. With -ons and -ez, no accent.

blocks.title: Word order and questions
blocks.note: The pronoun always sits **directly before the verb**. To ask a question, just raise your voice at the end, or put [[à quelle heure]] first.

examples.fr: Tu te lèves à quelle heure ?
examples.en: What time do you get up? (to a friend)

examples.fr: À quelle heure vous vous couchez ?
examples.en: What time do you go to bed? (formal)

blocks.title: With or without the pronoun?
blocks.body:
Many of these verbs also exist **without** the pronoun. Then the action is done to **someone else**:

- [[Je me réveille.]] = I wake up. / [[Je réveille ma fille.]] = I wake my daughter up.
- [[Je me couche.]] = I go to bed. / [[Je couche le bébé.]] = I put the baby to bed.
- [[Elle s'habille.]] = She gets dressed. / [[Elle habille son fils.]] = She dresses her son.

So the pronoun is not decoration: it changes the meaning.

- **Forgetting the pronoun:** [[Je lève à 7 heures]] ✗ → [[Je me lève à 7 heures]].
- **Wrong pronoun with nous:** [[Nous se levons]] ✗ → [[Nous nous levons]]. (With [[on]], it is [[se]]: [[On se lève]].)
- **No elision:** [[Je me habille]] ✗ → [[Je m'habille]].
- **Possessive with the body:** [[Je me brosse mes dents]] ✗ → [[Je me brosse les dents]]. The pronoun already says whose teeth they are.

blocks.title: What you will hear in Montréal
blocks.body:
In everyday speech, especially in Québec, the *e* of [[me]], [[te]] and [[se]] often disappears: [[je me lève]] sounds like *jm'lève*, [[tu te couches]] like *tu t'couches*. You will hear this in France too, but it is especially frequent in Québec.

Understand it when you hear it, but always **write** the full forms. And in a polite question you may hear inversion: [[À quelle heure vous levez-vous ?]] It means the same as [[À quelle heure vous vous levez ?]]

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Say the pronoun and the verb as one word.

lines.tip: lève has an open è, like “eh”.

lines.en: Do you wake up early? (to a friend)
lines.tip: réveilles ends in a y sound: ré-vèy.
Sounds exactly like il s'habille: listen to the context.
The t of dents is silent.

blocks.en: We go to bed at 11 p.m.

blocks.prompt: Mei is getting dressed. Which sentence is correct?
optionFeedback: se becomes s' before a vowel.
Without the pronoun, she is dressing someone else.
The verb must be conjugated: s'habille.

accept: Elle se lève à sept heures.
blocks.explain: elle → se; lève takes è because the ending is silent.

blocks.prompt: What time do you go to bed? (to a friend)
accept: Tu te couches à quelle heure ?
À quelle heure tu te couches ?
À quelle heure est-ce que tu te couches ?
blocks.explain: tu → te couches. The time question can go at the end or at the start.

blocks.prompt: We wake up at six o'clock.
accept: Nous nous réveillons à six heures.

blocks.prompt: Match each verb to its meaning.

blocks.explain: levez has no accent: the -ez ending is heard. [[tôt]] has a circumflex.

blocks.text: Mon fils ___ douze ans. Il ___ couche à 21 heures.
blocks.en: My son is twelve. He goes to bed at 9 p.m.
blocks.explain: Age uses avoir (il a douze ans); il → se couche.

blocks.prompt: I brush my teeth and I get dressed.
accept: Je me brosse les dents et je m'habille.
Je me lave les dents et je m'habille.
blocks.explain: Use [[les dents]], not [[mes dents]], and [[me]] → [[m']] before habille.

blocks.prompt: A new roommate wants to plan the bathroom schedule. Describe your morning with times, then ask about theirs.
checklist: Je me réveille / je me lève à…
Two more reflexive verbs (je me douche, je m'habille…)
Je me couche à… (tôt or tard)
A question: Et toi, tu te lèves à quelle heure ?

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Je me réveille à 6 h 30 et je me lève à 6 h 45. Je me douche à 7 heures, je m'habille et je me brosse les dents. Le soir, je me couche tôt, à 22 heures. Et toi, tu te lèves à quelle heure ?
models.en: I wake up at 6:30 and I get up at 6:45. I shower at 7, I get dressed and I brush my teeth. In the evening, I go to bed early, at 10. And you, what time do you get up?

blocks.prompt: Write a short message to a new roommate about your routine and the routine of one other person (a partner, a child, a friend).
checklist: Use at least four reflexive verbs
Use m' or s' before a vowel at least once
Write one sentence with il, elle or ils

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Alex ! Moi, je me lève tôt, à 6 heures. Je me douche et je m'habille. Ma fille Sofia se réveille à 7 heures. Elle se lave et elle s'habille. Le soir, nous nous couchons à 22 heures. Et toi ?
models.en: Hi Alex! Me, I get up early, at 6. I shower and get dressed. My daughter Sofia wakes up at 7. She washes and gets dressed. In the evening, we go to bed at 10. And you?

summary:
- Use reflexive pronouns before the verb: [[je me, tu te, il se, nous nous, vous vous, ils se]], with [[m', t', s']] before a vowel
- Describe your routine: [[je me réveille, je me lève, je me douche, je m'habille, je me couche]]
- Ask [[Tu te lèves à quelle heure ?]] and answer with [[tôt]] or [[tard]]
